tiers.label: Paid
tiers.description: Needs a paid self-serve plan (Pro, Business, Team)

tiers.label: Enterprise
tiers.description: Top plan only, usually through sales

tiers.label: Add-on
tiers.description: Sold separately on top of a plan

capabilities.label: SSO
capabilities.question: Can users sign in through the company identity provider (SAML or OIDC)?

capabilities.label: Enforce SSO
capabilities.question: Can admins require SSO and block password sign-in for all users?

capabilities.label: SCIM
capabilities.question: Can an identity provider create, update and deactivate users over SCIM? Partial means users only, or no deactivation.

capabilities.label: Enforce MFA
capabilities.question: Can admins require MFA for every user who signs in with the app's own login?

capabilities.label: Passkeys / keys
capabilities.question: Can users sign in with security keys or passkeys (WebAuthn / FIDO2)?

capabilities.label: Audit logs
capabilities.question: Can admins view a log of user and admin activity?

capabilities.label: JIT provisioning
capabilities.question: Are accounts created automatically on first SSO sign-in?

capabilities.label: Domain verification
capabilities.question: Can the company verify its email domain and take control of accounts that use it?

capabilities.label: Custom roles
capabilities.question: Can admins create roles with custom permissions beyond the built-in ones?

capabilities.label: Group → role mapping
capabilities.question: Can roles or team membership be assigned from identity provider groups?

capabilities.label: Session controls
capabilities.question: Can admins set session length or sign a user out of all sessions?

capabilities.label: API token controls
capabilities.question: Can admins see, restrict or revoke API tokens that users create?
